Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Vikram - 31 years, prince, son
Look: turban, blue angarkha, a sash
2. Meenakshi - 27 years, princess, daughter
Look: golden jewellery, green royal dress
3. Sunita - 64 years, queen, mother
Look: small crown, pink lehenga

Places

1. The training ground - an earth ground, a rack of weapons
2. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
4. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The training ground - Day

[Vikram stands on the training ground. Meenakshi and Sunita stand near him.]

Sunita: "Today feels like a good day."

[Vikram draws his bow and shoots an arrow at the target.]

Vikram (softly): "Careful!"

[Vikram mounts his horse and gallops away.]

Sunita (gently): "Vikram, look at this."

[Vikram swings his sword from the saddle of his horse.]

Meenakshi (gently): "Mother, are you okay?"

[Vikram shoots an arrow from his galloping horse.]

Meenakshi (gently): "One more time!"

[Meenakshi rides into the training ground on her horse.]

Meenakshi (gently): "I knew it!"

Scene 2: The terrace - Day

[Meenakshi stands on the terrace. Vikram stands near her.]

Vikram: "What a nice place."

[Meenakshi hangs the wet clothes on the line.]

Vikram: "Careful!"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Meenakshi stands in the courtyard. Sunita stands near her.]

Meenakshi: "Mother, look over here."

[Meenakshi washes clothes in a bucket.]

Meenakshi (surprised): "What next?"

Scene 4: The living room - Day

[Vikram stands in the living room. Sunita and Meenakshi stand near him.]

Sunita: "So, here we are!"

[Vikram pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Vikram: "Well done!"

[Vikram drinks a beer.]

Meenakshi: "That's great!"

[Vikram staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Vikram: "What happened?"

[Vikram and Mother clink their glasses.]

Vikram (laughing): "That was such a fun day!"
